claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_damage_type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has an always-on weapon rider that lets each hit from this specific weapon deal Lightning damage instead of its normal Piercing damage. The current surface can scope a passive rider to a specific item, but it cannot substitute a weapon attack's damage type without inventing a false numeric or direct-damage effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.
